feladatok.cim: Letter to Katie declining a housewarming party
feladatok.helyzet: You are staying in the USA as an exchange student and have received the following invitation from a schoolmate, Katie Morrison:

bemenet.cim: We found what makes a house a home…
bekezdesek: Lots of love, plenty of laughter and the presence of family and friends!
Please come and celebrate at a housewarming party with Sarah, Stan, Katie and Dan Morrison

feladatok.teendo: You cannot go because you are busy on Saturday. Write a letter of 60 words to Katie in which you include the following points:
iranyito_szempontok: ask two things about the new house

feladatok.cim: Letter to Samantha about becoming a model
feladatok.helyzet: You found the following letter in one of the teenage magazines you occasionally read. Readers were invited to give their opinion on the problem.

bekezdesek: I am a 16-year-old girl living in a big city. I am tall and have an attractive face. Everyone admires my good looks and says I look perfect ( I am not bragging). I want to become a professional model and use my face to earn money and fame. But my parents want me to become a doctor or engineer, something respectable. What shall I do? Please help!

feladatok.teendo: Write a letter of 110 words to Samantha in which you give her advice. Include the following points:
iranyito_szempontok: the advantages of being a model
the disadvantages of being a model
what you would do if you were Samantha
